title: Error-Driven Scene Editing for 3D Grounding in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.14086v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite recent progress in 3D-LLMs, they remain limited in accurately grounding language to visual and spatial elements in 3D environments. This limitation stems in part from training data that focuses on language reasoning rather than spatial understanding due to scarce 3D resources, leaving inherent grounding biases unresolved. To address this, we propose 3D scene editing as a key mechanism to generate visual counterfactuals that mitigate these biases through fine-grained spatial manipulation, without requiring costly scene reconstruction or large-scale 3D data collection. translated_title: 面向大语言模型3D定位的错误驱动场景编辑
translated_abstract: 尽管3D大语言模型（3D-LLMs）近来取得了进展，但它们在将语言准确对应到3D环境中的视觉与空间元素方面仍然受限。这一局限部分源于训练数据的问题——由于3D资源稀缺，现有训练数据侧重于语言推理而非空间理解，导致固有的定位偏差未能得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们提出将3D场景编辑作为一种关键机制，通过细粒度的空间操控生成视觉反事实样本，从而缓解这些偏差，且无需昂贵的场景重建或大规模3D数据收集。此外，为了使这些编辑具有针对性并直接解决模型的特定弱点，我们提出了DEER-3D——一个错误驱动的框架，通过结构化的“分解、诊断、编辑与再训练”循环来诊断定位失败并生成有针对性的反事实训练监督。具体而言，给定一个定位失败案例，DEER-3D首先……
tldr: 提出DEER-3D框架，通过错误驱动的“分解-诊断-编辑-再训练”循环对3D场景进行针对性编辑，生成视觉反事实训练数据，以修正3D大语言模型固有的语言定位偏差，且无需昂贵的场景重建或大规模3D数据收集。
en_tdlr: DEER-3D is an error-driven framework that diagnoses grounding failures in 3D-LLMs and generates targeted visual counterfactuals through 3D scene editing via a structured "Decompose, Diagnose, Edit, and Retrain" loop, correcting inherent grounding biases without costly scene reconstruction or large-scale 3D data collection.
